platform: LINUX-CPU only. MediaPipe pose (tools/latency-bench/linux_pose_extract.py) + D-FINE COCO-proxy paddle detector (CPU). This is an OPERATIONAL PROBE of the pipeline, NOT the canonical Apple Vision / Mac cascade. No iPhone or Mac measurements exist in this workstream and none are claimed.

method.inventory: Enumerated every never-tuned-against item from datasets/pickleball/registry.json (freshCandidates + devPool). Cross-checked for labels/references anywhere in datasets/ and ml/ (none exist outside registry.json). Searched all remote branches and wave-g artifacts for 'g18' acquisitions: wave-g branches g16-gen-matrix, g17-worst-slice, g19-oracle-waterfall exist; NO g18 branch or artifact exists in the repo, so nothing additional to inventory.
method.stage1: Pose-free mechanical gates on all 15 clips: frame analyzability + pre-analysis OOD gate + capture-envelope evaluator (h16-fresh-eval.ts -> h16-stage1-posefree-gates.json). Label-free.
method.stage2: Full Linux-available swing-lab pipeline (analyzeVideo.ts: player tracking, event pre-pass, paddle detect/track, ball track, contact estimation, phase segmentation, stroke resolution) on all 15 clips using MediaPipe pose extracts (h16-aggregate.py -> h16-stage2-linux-probe.json). Label-free; grouped per uploader/session, clips never counted as frames.
method.labels: ZERO labels created. The 12 fresh_candidate clips are label-blind holdout (policy: docs/HANDOFF_V4_DRAFT.md, wave-e e08 precedent) and were not tuned against. Annotation work-orders prepared in h16-annotation-pack.json.

inventory.note: Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were not viewed, labeled, tuned against, or regenerated.

measuredResults.onlyAnalyzedClip: yt-o_NeuHjTEVE (dev_label_eligible, BT Pickleball session) — analyzed end-to-end AFTER the P1 detect-span fix; before the fix the same clip lost all paddle evidence to an inverted detector span.
measuredResults.accuracyOnFreshFootage: NOT MEASURABLE — zero human labels exist on any fresh clip, so there is no ground-truth denominator. No accuracy numbers are claimed.

zeroFreshEvidence.strokeFamiliesNote: All 9 supported stroke families (packages/shared-types/src/pickleballTaxonomy.ts) have ZERO labeled fresh evidence — no fresh clip has any stroke/event/contact/target label.
zeroFreshEvidence.conditionsNote: All 7 named conditions have ZERO labeled fresh evidence. Several fresh clips visibly contain doubles play per their titles, but without labels this is coverage of footage, not evidence of correct behavior.

P1.severity: P1 (excess abstention on supported capture; silent paddle-evidence loss)
P1.description: planDetectSpanHull (packages/swing-lab/src/detectSpanPlan.ts) produced an INVERTED span (startMs > endMs, spanMs negative) whenever the pose pre-pass event hull fell entirely outside the detected stroke window. The paddle detector then decoded zero frames and the pipeline silently continued with 'no_tracks_formed' / no_paddle_evidence. Observed on dev-pool clip yt-o_NeuHjTEVE (detectSpan startMs=36971 > endMs=35869, spanMs=-1103).
P1.fix: Fall back to the full stroke window when the clamped hull is empty/inverted (same behavior as zero pre-pass events). Regression tests added in packages/swing-lab/test/detectSpanPlan.test.ts (events before and after the window).
P1.holdoutContamination: None — discovered and verified exclusively on a dev_label_eligible clip; no label-blind fresh candidate was used to tune the fix.
P1.verification: Same clip re-run post-fix: detectSpan spanMs=2034 (full window), paddle tracked, outcome 'analyzed'.

P2.description: packages/capture-envelope test 'heavy synthetic motion blur is detected on motion_blur' times out (5s vitest limit) under heavy CPU contention; passes on an idle machine. Flaky-under-load only, not a product defect.

externallyBlocked: Canonical accuracy on fresh footage requires human (Tier-A/B) labels; the 12-clip fresh pool is label-blind until an approved evaluation freeze — labeling now would destroy its holdout value.
Canonical Apple Vision / Mac cascade and iPhone on-device measurements are unavailable on Linux; the Linux MediaPipe probe cannot substitute for them.

Fresh footage supply remains thin (10 fresh sessions, mostly far-court broadcast-style video that honestly fails the capture gate); additional lawful near-court footage acquisition is an external task.
verdictRationale: Fresh generalization can NOT honestly be called certified. What exists: 15 never-tuned-against clips across 13 sessions, full Linux-probe coverage (15/15), honest gate behavior (14 abstentions/rejections, 1 analyzed, 0 silent failures, 0 fabricated outputs). What is missing, quantified: (1) ZERO human-labeled fresh clips — every accuracy claim on fresh footage has an empty denominator; (2) all 9 stroke families and all 7 named conditions have zero labeled fresh evidence; (3) zero canonical-platform (Apple Vision/Mac/iPhone) runs on any fresh clip; (4) only 1 of 15 fresh clips even passes the capture gate on the Linux probe, so the current fresh pool cannot demonstrate supported-envelope success at any statistically meaningful session count. Minimum to certify: an approved label freeze, Tier-A/B labels on the fresh pool (or newly acquired supported-envelope fresh sessions), canonical-platform runs, and per-family/per-condition accuracy with real denominators.
